title: SaveProviderRequest
description: Parameters for providers.save, which creates a profile when id is absent and updates it otherwise. This is the only contract in the whole set that carries an API key, and it travels in one direction only: renderer to host. Nothing ever sends a key back (CLAUDE.md §0.2.13).

id.description: Identifier of the profile to update. Absent when creating a new one.

providerType.description: Which provider family this profile talks to. The values match ProviderType on the outbound side.

displayName.description: Name the user gave this profile.

baseUrl.description: Endpoint override. Required for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, optional elsewhere.

apiKey.description: The secret, sent only when the user entered or changed it. Absent on an update that leaves the existing key alone. The host writes it straight to the secret store and never returns it.
